title: Signature Weapon
description: Create your own unique, distinctive weapon. To start with, **choose its base** (or create a new one with the GM).  Choose 2 enhancements and then name it (Ataraxia, Cryptbreaker etc)

bullets: Alarming - it glows in the presence of one creature type
Grappling - after inflicting DMG, you can pull a target closer to you
Pinning - after inflicting DMG on a creature your size or smaller, you can have it stay there and immobilize them
